dialogues.speaker: Examine Board
dialogues.text: (Seems like there's a board outside Wangsheng Funeral Parlor with lots of blank wooden tiles hanging from it... Hmm... what are they for?)

dialogues.speaker: Examine Board
dialogues.text: (Never mind, I'm not sure I want to find out.)

dialogues.speaker: Examine Board
dialogues.text: (A board outside Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Clients use the wooden tiles to write down their commissions, before sliding them under the crack of the door.)

dialogues.speaker: Examine Board
dialogues.text: (Hu Tao's advertisements can be found on the back of each tile: "Buy one get free for the holder of this tile.")
